method: Actual Godot GPU PNGs from the unchanged baseline marker functions and fixed candidate functions through full native layer/area reduction. Three-row cross-sections halfway along the left bracket arm or ghost left border; stroke coverage is inferred from alpha above the measured fill plateau. Core width uses >0.5 inferred stroke coverage. Different vector antialias/pixel-area rasterization can change coverage; native and direct images are not claimed pixel-identical.
